scenario: cold launch from an isolated profile whose derived History spill index is marked as reconciling

ui.evidenceMethod: live CUA accessibility tree after launch of the app extracted from the PKG

result: pass: the packaged app cold-launched from a cloned profile marked as reconciling and displayed the selected healthy conversation; the derived index completed during startup. The UI sample does not establish that its page read happened before reconciliation completed.
limitations: the PKG was expanded and its app payload launched under an isolated identity; the PKG was not installed
the UI sample is synthetic and n=1
the exact ordering between the selected page read and index reconciliation was not captured; the source regression test deterministically covers the pending-index ordering
this does not close AC-7, P4-02, or P4-03
